title: KCP snapshot_read result (DESIGN.md §11.5, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for snapshot_read (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of snapshot items (open item shape, gap note KG28) (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Snapshot item: the collection's record projection. Each collection's typed shape is pinned by its own *_list result; the generic snapshot item stays open (gap note KG28) and carries no authority.
Page of snapshot items; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit). Current revocation or erasure may remove an item even from the historical set (§11.5).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).
